name: imagor-mcp
description: An MCP server and a skill for imagor. An agent writes a layout (OG cards, product grids, quotes) and it compiles to one imagor URL.

imagor_base_url.title: imagor base URL
imagor_base_url.description: Where imagor is running, for example http://localhost:8000.

imagor_unsafe.title: IMAGOR_UNSAFE
imagor_unsafe.description: Set to 1 when the imagor server runs in unsafe mode. Leave empty when it is signed.

imagor_secret.title: IMAGOR_SECRET
imagor_secret.description: The signing secret, when the imagor server is signed. Must match the server's own secret and signer settings.

imagor_signer_type.title: IMAGOR_SIGNER_TYPE
imagor_signer_type.description: Signature algorithm the imagor server uses: sha1 (default), sha256 or sha512. Must match the server or emitted URLs will not validate.

imagor_signer_truncate.title: IMAGOR_SIGNER_TRUNCATE
imagor_signer_truncate.description: Signature length in characters, when the imagor server truncates signatures. Must match the server.
